item.mng: yeke dandr-a-yin qaγan čoγtu üneger barilduγulqui dusul

item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini kay-a st*aba ghay-a ḍara-yin ba-a-da kiged, töbed-ün kelemürči saky-a-lig-ud-un ayaγ-qa / {ayaγ-qa} tegimlig belge bilig-tü orčiγulǰu, nayiraγul-un orosiγulbai. ǰiči basa busu töbed-ün kelemürčid busud-un orči/γuluγsan üges-i öber-e bolγan ǰasaǰu, öber-ün nereben oroγulǰu busud-un ner-e-yi arčiγči tedeger kiged, tedeger ülü / medegčin uyidqaqu-yin tula ǰiči basa enedkeg-ün dörben ṱandir-a kiged, sakyaliγ-ud-un ayaγ-qa tegimlig belge bilig-tü tere öber-iyen / büged tokiyalduγul-un ǰasaǰu orosiγulbai. qoyitu sang rtag-un üy-e-tür qoyar γurbanta nayiraγulbai. merged-ün büston yeke ubadini-yi sudur-luγ-a / tokiyalduγulǰu γurbanta nayiraγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-tür kündga odser manǰusiri bandida-tur dulduyidču, mati badra sagara šri padr-a toyin <čorǰi> orčiγulbai. , .
